repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
t1 = (#Study_Temp).temperatureSensor_temperature
delay(20 MIN)
t2 = (#Study_Temp).temperatureSensor_temperature
diff = t2 - t1
if (diff >= 3) {
    (#Study_AC).airConditioner_setAirConditionerMode("cool")
}

diagnosis.summary: The candidate incorrectly computes absolute value by converting negative differences to positive (lines 5-7), changing the IR's semantics from detecting temperature INCREASE of >= 3 to detecting ANY temperature change of >= 3 in magnitude. F2 shows IR emitted no action at 1200000ms but JoI did, because temperature was held constant (diff=0) so IR correctly didn't trigger, but candidate triggered due to absolute value logic.
diagnosis.change_summary: Removed the absolute value conversion block (lines 5-7) that was converting negative differences to positive. This preserves the IR's exact semantics where only t2 - t1 >= 3 (temperature increase) triggers the action, not any large absolute change.
